entries.title: Saturn-Like Planetary Ring Orbit Simulator
entries.description: A central pastel-colored planet with thousands of small particles forming a flat ring that orbit, collide, clump into moonlets, and leave faint trails, while labels mark ring gaps and a slider gradually tilts the ring plane.

entries.title: Shepherd Moons and Ring Gap Formation
entries.description: Two small labeled shepherd moons orbit inside a bright particle ring around a planet, gravitationally clearing a visible gap as ring particles bounce, get scattered, or temporarily attach as glowing clusters.

entries.title: Ring Resonance Wave Propagation
entries.description: A narrow ring of particles around a planet where a passing moon induces spiral density waves that propagate as pulsing bright bands through the ring, with particles slightly shifting orbits and leaving curved trails.

entries.title: Debris Ring Around a Dwarf Planet

entries.title: Asteroid Belt Ring Around a Star
entries.description: A bright star with a broad, dusty asteroid ring where larger asteroids have small orbiting moonlets, collisions create temporary dust clouds, and semi-transparent dust smoothly diffuses outward.
